candidate.title: fixture counter increments before the device is armed
candidate.problem: fixture_count() increments when fixture_ready() is true even before fixture_armed(), so the recorded count is one too high on the pinned baseline.
candidate.patch_diff:
diff --git a/drivers/fixture/fixture_counter.c b/drivers/fixture/fixture_counter.c
--- a/drivers/fixture/fixture_counter.c
+++ b/drivers/fixture/fixture_counter.c
@@ -10,7 +10,7 @@ static int fixture_count(void)
 int count = 0;
 
-if (fixture_ready())
+if (fixture_ready() && fixture_armed())
 count++;
 
 return count;
diff --git a/include/fixture/fixture_counter.h b/include/fixture/fixture_counter.h
--- a/include/fixture/fixture_counter.h
+++ b/include/fixture/fixture_counter.h
@@ -3,4 +3,5 @@
 #define FIXTURE_COUNTER_H
 
 int fixture_count(void);
+int fixture_armed(void);
 
 #endif

cover_letter.subject: drivers/fixture: arm the counter before counting
cover_letter.body: The fixture counter increments before the device is armed, so the recorded count is one too high on the pinned baseline. This change gates the increment on fixture_armed() and declares the helper in the header. Reproducer, test matrix and limits of verification are in the attached dossier.
